The run directories of `status-run`, `status-cycle`, `status-coordination` and `status-error` were made in a scratch tree, and its prefix is replaced by `/home/claude/fx`; run.env, runbook.md and sessions.tsv were written by hand, the invocations of `status-cycle` by the coordinator's `tools/invocation.py` and their end records by `tools/ended.py`'s `record()`. None of these run directories is kept here; only the output is.

- `status-run.json`: a run directory named `autoflow-sandbox-3-sample` (the coordinator's `<repo>-<issue>-<key>` form) with run.env (`TERMINAL=tmux`, `ISSUE=3`, `BRANCH=issue-3-sample`, `STATE=active`), two sessions in sessions.tsv whose claude processes are gone, no records folder, and three rows in runbook.md's progress table under `- Reference: analysis-review` (a pass, a missed verdict and a noted one). Recorded with `tools/status.py <that directory>`.
- `status-cycle.json`: a run directory named `autoflow-sandbox-5-cycle` (`ISSUE=5`, `RECORDS` its records folder, `MODULES` a clone of autoflow-module at 469ec2c) with five invocations written by `tools/invocation.py` in this order: `analysis-1`, `build-1`, `review-1`, `build-2` (input `findings` from `review-1`) and `review-2` (input `previous_findings` from `review-1`), each with its end record (its work folder empty); a progress row for each, `review-1` missed and the others pass; three sessions whose processes are gone. `build-2` is a return caused by `review-1` and `review-2` a rerun of it. Recorded with `tools/status.py <that directory>`.
- `status-error.json`: a run directory named `broken` without run.env.
- `status-coordination.json`: a run directory named `autoflow-sandbox-3-coord` with run.env (`TERMINAL=tmux`, `ISSUE=3`, `BRANCH=issue-3-coord`, `COORD_SURFACE=%34`, `STATE=active`), no sessions.tsv, and a runbook.md with `- Reference: review-only: sample` and an empty progress table.
- `status-none.json`: `tools/status.py` without a run, with `HOME` a scratch folder holding no runs: no active runs.
- `status-reviews.json`: `tools/status.py <run directory>` on the operator's run `autoflow-coordinator-119-2026-11-19-180359-3cbd8c18` of autoflow-coordinator issue #119, where it is, after the run was closed (its sessions' turns and idle times are from the real transcripts), with the replacements below. Its steps: rows outside AutoFlow (`S1 …`, `X1 …`), three `review` module runs with `out` and `result: "ended"`, and two reruns (`review-2` ← `review-1`, `review-3` ← `review-2`) with their verdict text and notes.

Module run records of the same run, in `records/autoflow-coordinator-119-2026-11-19-180359-3cbd8c18` (made by autoflow-coordinator 0.8.0-rc1, commit 2d6654a, with autoflow-module 469ec2c as the modules), and its run directory in `runs/autoflow-coordinator-119-2026-11-19-180359-3cbd8c18`:

- `review-1`, `review-2` and `review-3`: each its invocation file `<name>.invocation.json`, its end record `<name>.ended.json`, and its work folder's `report.md`, `reviews/claude.md` and `reviews/codex.md`, copied byte for byte. `review-1/reviews/claude.md` is a reviewer's report written in Korean, kept as it is.

The repository is public, so in the copied invocations, end records, run.env, runbook.md and sessions.tsv, and in `status-reviews.json`, these were replaced by one Python script (Python 3.15) of plain string replacements, in this order, with nothing else changed:

- the operator's home: `<home>/.autoflow/coordination-module/records` → `/home/claude/fx/records`, `<home>/.autoflow/coordination-module/runs` → `/home/claude/fx/runs`, `<home>/work/coordinator` → `/home/claude/fx/base`, `<home>/work/<folder>` (the folder holding the operator's clones) → `/home/claude/fx/work`, and the rest of `<home>` → `/home/claude`;
- tmux ids: the window of the coordination session → `@1`, and the panes of the coordination session, S1, S2 and X1 → `%1`, `%2`, `%3`, `%4`;
- session ids: the coordination session's, S1's, S2's and X1's → `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001` to `…004`, each the same everywhere it occurs;
- the operator's words quoted verbatim in runbook.md (four quotes, in English and Korean) → `"<operator's instruction>"`, `"<operator's approval>"`, `"<operator's merge report>"` and `"<operator's closing instruction>"`, the line and its other text kept;
- the claude.ai link in X1's row (and so in that step's `verdict_text`) → `https://example.com/artifact`;
- email addresses → `operator@example.com`: none was in the copied files, so none was replaced.

Kept as they are: the tilde paths `~/work/autoflow-module`, `~/work/coordinator` and the like in runbook.md and `review-1/reviews/claude.md`, which are the coordinator's documented defaults and a reviewer's examples, not the operator's folders.

Screens recorded from Claude Code, in `screens/`, used in `tests/test_screens.py` and `tests/test_app.py` (#79). Each is the stdout of `tmux capture-pane -p -t <pane>` (tmux 3.8, on the operator's Mac) of a pane running Claude Code; none is a screen written for the tests. The repository is public, so personal data in them was replaced before they were committed, by a Python script (Python 3.15) of plain string replacements, with nothing else changed: the account's plan after the model (→ `Claude Plan`); the home folders in the header and in the text (`~/work/<folder>/coordination` → `~/coordinator`, `~/work/<folder>/autoflow-ide-runs` → `~/autoflow-ide`, `/Users/<name>/` → `~/`, a worktree under the coordinator's base → `~/…/coordinator-wt`); the GitHub owner (`<owner>/Autoflow-ide` → `owner/Autoflow-ide`); the operator's status line below the input area, which shows cost and token figures, replaced by `⚠ status: cost and token figures removed` (the line stays, below the lower rule); and the token count of a working spinner (`↓ 1.0k tokens`). The rules (`─`), the input area's prompt `❯` followed by a no-break space (U+00A0), a dialog's cursor `❯` followed by a space, the dialog's lines and the blank rows are as recorded.

- `choice-prompt.txt`: Claude Code v2.1.326, the coordination session of this repository's issue #79 asking which workflow to run (`☐ Workflow`, `❯ 1. analysis-review (Recommended)` … `5. Chat about this`, `Enter to select · ↑/↓ to navigate · Esc to cancel`): a rule above the dialog and one inside it, no input area. Recorded on 2026-11-18 by a loop that captured every pane every 5 seconds.
- `choice-prompt-80.txt`: the same dialog in the coordination session of issue #80, one of the 24 captures, 5 seconds apart, it showed for (2026-11-17); the captures before and after it are not prompts.
- `permission-prompt.txt`: Claude Code v2.1.316, a Bash permission dialog (`Do you want to proceed?`, `❯ 1. Yes`, `2. No`, `Esc to cancel · Tab to amend`) of a session started with `--permission-mode default --settings '{"permissions":{"ask":["Bash"]}}'`: one `─` rule above `Bash command`, `╌` lines (U+254C, not a rule), no input area. Printed by the coordinator's `tools/terminals/tmux.py` `screen()` (`tmux capture-pane -p -t <pane>` with trailing blank lines removed) in a check run of autoflow-coordinator issue #20 (2026-10-31), and copied from its log.
- `working.txt`: Claude Code v2.1.326, the session of `choice-prompt.txt` six seconds earlier, at work (`✻ Contemplating…`) with a tool's output that quotes every pattern more than 12 lines above the bottom, and an empty input area between two rules.
- `turn-end.txt`: Claude Code v2.1.326, the same session at the end of a turn (`✻ Cogitated for 2m 1s · done`), an empty input area.
- `background-agent.txt`: Claude Code v2.1.326, a session of issue #80's run whose analysis module was checked in, waiting for a background agent (`✻ Waiting for 1 background agent to finish`), an empty input area.

The tests also build screens from these: words of a prompt put above the input area, as a report or a tool's output quotes them, with and without a draft (`❯` and `my draft`) in the input area; a recorded prompt followed by more lines and an input area; and trailing blank rows added.
